findings.visa_assessment:
CRITICAL FINDING: nilfamtravel.com uses «بدون نیاز به ویزا» (no visa needed) in multiple places:

1. AROYA Türkiye+Egypt route: The «بدون نیاز به ویزا» claim appears VALID for this route per the README (AROYA's Türkiye+Egypt routes are truly visa-free). The itinerary includes Marmaris, Kas, and Istanbul (Türkiye) and Alexandria (Egypt, though Iranian passengers cannot disembark). However, they also list Jeddah (Saudi Arabia) as a destination under «بدون نیاز به ویزا», which would need verification.

2. Persian Gulf MSC Euribia route: The page labels cabin prices as «نرخ بدون ویزا» (no-visa rate), which is MISLEADING. Persian Gulf (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Qatar, Bahrain) is EASY VISA, not no-visa, per the README. Critically, the SAME PAGE also lists «خدمات ویزای مالتی امارات» (UAE multi-entry visa service) as an included service — directly contradicting the «بدون ویزا» label. The page uses «نرخ بدون ویزا» as a pricing tier label, which falsely implies no visa is needed.

3. The main cruise page lists «کروز بدون نیاز ویزا» as a category heading, under which both Türkiye AROYA routes AND «مسیر امارات قطر بحرین (۱۰ روزه)» (UAE/Qatar/Bahrain 10-day route) appear, implying the Persian Gulf route is also visa-free.
findings.notes: Nilfam claims to be «نخستین نماینده رسمی کشتی های کروز MSC در ایران» (first official MSC Cruises representative in Iran) and «نماینده رسمی Aroya Cruises» (official AROYA Cruises representative). The AROYA Türkiye itinerary (Marmaris → Kas → Alexandria → Istanbul) notes that «مسافران ایرانی مجاز به پیاده شدن از کشتی در این بندر نیستند» (Iranian passengers are not allowed to disembark at Alexandria/Egypt port).

findings.visa_assessment: zhivar.com does NOT make any «بدون ویزا» claims. They list «ویزا» (visa) as an included service («☑ ویزا خدمات اخذ ویزا») for all cruise tours. For Brazil cruises, they require valid employment documents and bank statements (implying Schengen/Brazil visa is needed). For Abu Dhabi/Dubai and Gulf cruises, they note that no financial proof or employment certificate is needed, but still list visa as an included service. No false visa claims found.
findings.notes: Zhivar claims to be «نماینده رسمی MSC کروز در ایران» (official MSC Cruise representative in Iran) in the cruise tour listing page title and meta description. They sell Brazil (two variants), Abu Dhabi/Dubai (4-day), and Persian Gulf (8-day) MSC cruise tours. Two Brazil cruise tours are listed separately — one labeled «برزیل کشتی کروز» and one «برزیل کشتی کروز MSC» — with different pricing (the MSC-labeled one is cheaper). The zhivar.com domain was confirmed via Google search — multiple domains exist (zhivar.com, zhiwaar.com, zhivar.net) but zhivar.com is the primary site with cruise content.
